chunks: He (peace be upon him) was asked:
How would Allah conduct the accounting of the creation despite their large number?
ai.seo_question: How does God account for every individual on Judgment Day given the vast number of people?
ai.summary: In this passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses the logical concern of how divine justice can be executed with precision amidst billions of souls, emphasizing that God’s knowledge is not diluted by quantity. This reflects the Shia theological principle that divine attributes are absolute and independent of created limitations, ensuring that every individual’s deeds are weighed with exactitude. The answer underscores the concept of *‘Ilm al-Ilahi* (Divine Knowledge) as all-encompassing, removing any doubt about the feasibility of universal accountability.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 300. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, was asked:
How Allāh would conduct the accounting of all persons despite their large number.
